latent_blocker_audit.audit: The plan correctly requires one committed authority and pre-legacy rebind, but does not name the sole owning file/JSON pointer; contract, packet, and receipts are all told to freeze the values.

Attempt-011 central and fresh receipts are exact one-file commits in a single-parent chain. The generic binding itself has no receipt-commit inputs or commit-delta/ancestry replay, so the plan correctly requires Attempt-012-specific ancestry tests and rejects old receipts.

The retained predicate rejects five missing/mismatched fields. The Ultra/XHigh matrix is role-safe, but the plan does not name the independent source of actual model/reasoning attestations consumed by its pure predicate.
All 33 entries across the four frozen maps matched raw HEAD SHA-256, including duplicates across transitive layers. Additive Attempt-012 files and new raw bindings are correctly required.
Attempt-011 copies sys.argv[1:] into expected argv. The plan forbids that and requires independent derivation, but its external process-capture and exit-provenance artifact is undefined.

The no-reuse root invariant is sound. Byte-level immutability is not true during execution because retained persistence refreshes the four documents; the plan does not define the terminal seal boundary explicitly.
Nested finally preserves one F00 attempt and one F01 attempt, and the proposed mutation matrix covers S00/D/F00/F01 and A/B/C closure defects without authorizing second cleanup.
Attempt-011 source predicts SystemExit(2) but supplied outer exit was 1. Attempt-012 requires both values yet names no capture schema, path, producer, or binding mechanism.

finding_register.title: Gate 4/5 process capture and pre-root failure receipt are undefined
evidence: Plan lines 278-304 exhaustively name R0-R3 files but name no Attempt-012 outer failure or process-capture artifact.
Plan line 414 requires stdout/stderr hashes and separate raw-child/outer-tool exits.
Plan line 419 requires fresh Gate 5 to read process capture, and line 421 allows an outer control failure receipt for pre-root failure.
Static search found zero named Attempt-012 outer-failure/process-capture JSON paths.
finding_register.impact: A pre-root failure leaves no defined, byte-bound evidence carrier, and even a post-root run has no specified external capture carrier for the transport exit. Gate 5 therefore cannot independently replay the required exit and stream provenance and could consume stale, circular, or ad hoc evidence.
finding_register.required_plan_change_before_gate1: Define the exact conditional write set, canonical path, strict schema, sole producer, raw-child versus outer-tool status fields, stdout/stderr byte/hash fields, R3/cwd/argv/attempt bindings, commit/immutability rule, and Gate-5 replay predicate for one outer control capture receipt.

finding_register.title: One-shot consumption and confirmation freshness are declarative, not durably bound
evidence: R1 is required to keep runtime authorization false and exact command unconfirmed.
Gate 4 relies on a newly shown tuple and a static Attempt-012 token but names no dispatch or confirmation receipt.
A pre-root failure intentionally creates no output root, so no in-root marker can show that the sole invocation was consumed.
Static search found zero named Attempt-012 confirmation/dispatch JSON paths.
finding_register.impact: After a pre-root failure, the same cwd, argv, token, R2, and R3 can be replayed with no committed state proving consumption. This leaves a stale-confirmation/retry path contrary to one-shot/no-retry policy.
finding_register.required_plan_change_before_gate1: Specify a non-self-referential, durable dispatch/confirmation authority that binds the exact cwd and argv, becomes consumed before launch, survives pre-root failure, and is rejected on any second invocation without widening the runner write boundary.

finding_register.title: The claimed RED-to-GREEN flow does not require the same Attempt-012 candidate seam to be observed RED before the fix
evidence: Plan lines 326-338 require historical Attempt-011 to be RED before implementation and to remain RED afterward.
The Attempt-012 positive fixture is required only to be GREEN after implementation.
Gate 1 lines 374-381 do not require an R0 checkpoint where the Attempt-012 seam is run and recorded RED before the R1 adapter change.
finding_register.impact: The historical detector is red-capable, but the candidate regression test can be authored or adjusted with the fix and never demonstrate that it catches the missing Attempt-012 rebind at the actual call seam. This is not the test-first RED-to-GREEN evidence required by the diagnosis protocol.
finding_register.required_plan_change_before_gate1: Require the committed R0 test/harness to exercise the Attempt-012 dormant stub at the real pre-legacy handoff seam and record the expected stable RED code before R1; then require the identical test and fixture, without test changes, to turn GREEN at R1.

finding_register.title: The sole root-authority owner is not named
finding_register.evidence: The plan requires one committed root-authority record but says the helper, packet, and receipts must freeze the fields without identifying a canonical file and JSON pointer or precedence rule.
finding_register.impact: An implementation could accidentally duplicate authority or let a later receipt restate rather than bind the R1 authority.
finding_register.required_plan_change_before_gate1: Name one R1-owned authority object and require every other carrier to bind its raw bytes/hash rather than independently reconstruct its values.

finding_register.title: Output immutability terminology conflates root/roster immutability with byte immutability
finding_register.evidence: The plan calls the root immutable once created, while retained code refreshes the four documents at lines 786, 799, and 804 and writes final documents at lines 1068-1071.
finding_register.impact: The Gate-5 freshness boundary is ambiguous until a terminal seal point is defined.
finding_register.required_plan_change_before_gate1: Define mutable progress phase, atomic replacement expectations, terminal seal event, and the exact post-seal byte set Gate 5 may accept.

finding_register.title: Actual model/reasoning attestation source is unspecified
finding_register.evidence: The plan requires a pure model predicate and actual-value verification but does not identify the platform-owned metadata/attestation consumed as independent evidence.
finding_register.impact: Requested values could be copied into actual fields unless Gate owners use an external authoritative task-routing record.
finding_register.required_plan_change_before_gate1: Name the authoritative source and fail closed when actual model or reasoning is not observable; preserve service tier/speed as UNOBSERVABLE when telemetry is absent.

finding_register.title: The target hash is not a repository-unique literal
finding_register.evidence: The same literal/hash occurs in Attempt-006 line 627, Attempt-007 line 1018, and Attempt-008 line 670.
finding_register.impact: None after reachability analysis: Attempt-011's import/call chain uniquely reaches Attempt-008.main.
finding_register.disposition: Keep hash-wide and reachable-site claims separate.

finding_register.title: The latent model-policy failure is conditional on preceding gates
finding_register.evidence: The current documents fail five retained model fields, but the model predicate occurs after root, confirmation, repository, interpreter, HEAD, frozen-input, and receipt checks.
finding_register.impact: The distinct model hash is a valid latent prediction, not evidence that the model branch executed in Attempt-011.

verdict_rationale: Three major findings leave Gate 1 without a complete fail-closed authority/capture lifecycle and without required test-first candidate RED-to-GREEN evidence.
